title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash e1e275cf672d… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash e1e275cf672d481750730a3b46b1d1683ae030573533d3feed87f4e63196a9ac was observed by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors on 2026-11-14. The file was detected three times during attacker activity involving the T1105 technique (Ingress Tool Transfer) originating from attacker infrastructure in the Netherlands. This hash corresponds to a specific malicious payload such as a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. Organizations are advised to check their environments and security tools for this hash to identify potential compromise.
